title: Ex vivo stimulation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC)
author: John Davis Coakley
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6zzhf76

steps.title: Label 96‑well plate layout
steps.instruction: Label a flat‑bottom 96‑well microtiter plate so that wells in column A are designated “Medium (no stimulation)”, column B “P/I”, column C “LPS”, and column D “CD3/CD28 coated”.

steps.title: Coat CD3/CD28 wells (D2‑D7)
steps.instruction: Add 1 µg ml⁻¹ of each anti‑CD3 and anti‑CD28 monoclonal antibody in 0.1 M Na₂HPO₄, adjusted to pH 9 with 0.1 M NaH₂PO₄, to wells D2‑D7. Incubate 4 to 24 h, then aspirate and wash once with 100 µl PBS.

steps.title: Add PBMCs to wells
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.5 × 10⁶ peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) into each well in 200 µl complete RPMI medium.

steps.title: Incubate cells and prepare antibody cocktails
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 5 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Meanwhile, prepare antibody cocktails for each sample in 50 µl PBS‑BSA (PBA) and label the corresponding flow‑cytometry tubes.

steps.title: Add stimulants to designated wells
steps.instruction: Add 50 ng ml⁻¹ PMA and 1 µg ml⁻¹ Ionomycin to wells B1‑B7; add 0.05 µg ml⁻¹ LPS to well C1; add 10 µg ml⁻¹ Brefeldin A to wells A1‑A3, A6, B1‑B3, B6, C1, D2, D3, and D6.

steps.title: Transfer cells to flow tubes and dead‑cell stain
steps.instruction: After mixing the contents of each well (avoiding bubbles), transfer the cells to the pre‑labeled flow‑cytometry tubes, add 1 ml PBS, centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, resuspend in dead‑cell stain, vortex, and incubate 15 min at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBA after staining
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml PBA to each tube, vortex, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 min (as in step 7). Discard supernatant.

steps.title: Surface antibody staining
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate surface‑antibody cocktail (prepared in 50 µl PBA) to each tube, vortex, incubate 15 min in the dark, then add 1 ml PBA, vortex, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilise wells 1‑3,6
steps.instruction: For tubes originating from wells 1, 2, 3, and 6 of columns A‑D: fix with 0.5 ml 4 % PFA, incubate 10 min in the dark; add 1 ml PBA, vortex, centrifuge (1500 rpm 5 min); permeabilise with 1 ml 0.2 % saponin, incubate 10 min in the dark; centrifuge; add intracellular antibody cocktail (prepared in 50 µl 0.2 % saponin‑PBA), vortex, incubate 20 min in the dark; add 1 ml PBA, vortex, centrifuge; resuspend in 0.5 ml 1 % PFA, incubate 10 min in the dark; add 1 ml PBA, vortex, centrifuge; top up with a few drops of PBA and store at 4 °C until acquisition.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilise wells 4,5,7
steps.instruction: For tubes originating from wells 4, 5, and 7 of columns A‑D: add 1 ml Fixation/Permeabilisation Solution, incubate 30 min in the dark; add 1 ml PBA, vortex, centrifuge (1500 rpm 5 min); add 1 ml Permeabilisation Buffer, vortex, centrifuge; add intracellular antibody cocktail (prepared in 50 µl Permeabilisation Buffer), vortex, incubate 30 min in the dark in the fridge; add 1 ml cold permeabilisation buffer, centrifuge; resuspend in 1 % PFA, vortex, incubate 10 min in the dark; add 1 ml PBA, vortex, centrifuge; top up with a few drops of PBA and store at 4 °C until acquisition.
